data.gender_notes: Koteswara is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Koteswara is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Koti' meaning 'million' and 'Iswara' meaning 'god'. This name signifies the goddess who grants victory in all forms and aspects of life. The name Koteswara carries the meaning “Goddess of victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Koteswara usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine feminine power of victory, strength, and protection.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Koteswara total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Koteswara is rich in Indian mythology and culture. It is particularly associated with the goddess Kali, who is also known by various other names like Durga, Parvati, and Shakti among others. In Hindu traditions, Kali is often depicted as a powerful mother goddess, protector of the universe, and destroyer of evil forces. The name Koteswara emphasizes her role as a goddess of supreme power, who can grant victory in all spheres of life, and is revered by many Hindus.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Koteswara holds immense spiritual significance for those who seek her blessings. It is believed that Goddess Koteswara represents the divine power that can overcome all challenges and obstacles in life. By invoking her name, one can seek her protection, strength, and guidance to overcome negative influences and achieve success in all areas of life. It is also believed that the goddess bestows her grace upon her devotees, granting them peace, prosperity, and happiness. The name Koteswara serves as a reminder of the infinite power and grace of the divine, and inspires devotion, faith, and deep spiritual connection among her followers.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Koteswara represents the divine warrior goddess, guardian of treasures and wealth. Her name signifies one who is adorned with victory symbols, symbolizing her victories over obstacles and challenges. She is the embodiment of strength, courage, and prosperity.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Koteswara is a name of Lord Shiva, mentioned in the Shiva Purana. The name Koteswara carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
